summary: This sermon casts vision for Canvas Community Church's 2024 direction by unpacking their mission, vision, and core values. The pastor emphasizes creating an authentic Christ-centered community that welcomes real people with real struggles, prioritizes kingdom growth over church growth, and unites around the gospel while holding secondary theological opinions with an open hand.
key_points: Mission: invite real people into Christ-centered community
Vision: cultivate God's kingdom by proclaiming and obeying Jesus
Unite for the gospel, holding secondary theology loosely
Prioritize authentic relationships over event attendance
Pursue multiplication and church partnerships over expansion
big_idea: The church exists to create an authentic Christ-centered community where real people can encounter Jesus, so that God's kingdom becomes more visible through both bold proclamation and sacrificial obedience.
title: Looking Ahead: Our Mission, Vision, & Values
